alternative.src/scopes.mjs: export function matches(pattern,resource){const p=pattern.split('/'),r=resource.split('/');for(let i=0;i<p.length;i++){if(p[i]==='**')return true;if(i>=r.length||(p[i]!=='*'&&p[i]!==r[i]))return false;}return p.length===r.length;}

mutants.name: deny-loses-to-allow
mutants.replacement: import {matches} from './scopes.mjs';export function authorize(roles,action,resource){const grants=[],denies=[];for(const role of roles)for(const rule of role.rules)if((rule.action==='*'||rule.action===action)&&matches(rule.resource,resource))(rule.effect==='deny'?denies:grants).push(role.name);const unique=a=>[...new Set(a)];return denies.length&&!grants.length?{allowed:false,reason:'explicit-deny',roles:unique(denies)}:grants.length?{allowed:true,reason:'grant',roles:unique(grants)}:{allowed:false,reason:'no-grant',roles:[]};}

mutants.name: recursive-wildcard-requires-child
mutants.replacement: export function matches(pattern,resource){const p=pattern.split('/'),r=resource.split('/');if(p.at(-1)==='**'){p.pop();if(r.length<=p.length)return false;}else if(p.length!==r.length)return false;return p.every((s,i)=>s==='*'||s===r[i]);}
